config.description: TVmaze API base URL. Override to point at an enterprise endpoint.

config.label: User-Agent sent on every upstream request
config.description: User-Agent sent on every upstream request. TVmaze asks that clients identify themselves. Defaults to the server name, version, and repository URL.

config.description: IANA timezone used when a tool call omits 'timezone' (e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles').

config.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used for tvmaze_get_schedule scopes 'linear' and 'all' when 'country' is omitted.

config.label: Seconds to hold an upstream response in the in-process cache
config.description: Seconds to hold an upstream response in the in-process cache. 0 disables caching.
